chunks: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan ibn Ahmad ibn al-Walid (may God be pleased with him) narrated to us. He said: Ahmad ibn Alawiyya narrated to us from Ibrahim ibn Muhammad. He said: Al-Mas'udi narrated to us. He said: Ali ibn al-Qasim al-Kindi narrated to us from Sa'd ibn Talib from Uthman ibn al-Qasim al-Ansari from Zayd ibn Arqam. He said:

The Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) said: Shall I not guide you to that by which, if you follow it, you will never be destroyed or go astray? They said: Of course, O Messenger of God.
He said: Verily, your Imam and your wali is Ali ibn Abi Talib. So consult him, refer to him, and believe him, for Gabriel commanded me of this.

key_terms.إمام: Imam — the divinely appointed leader of the Muslim community after the Prophet
key_terms.جبرئيل: Gabriel — the archangel who conveys divine revelation to the Prophet
key_terms.صدقوه: Believe him / affirm him — accept his statements as true
key_terms.ناصحوه: Refer to him sincerely — follow his guidance without reservation
key_terms.وازروه: Consult him / support him — seek his counsel and assistance
key_terms.ولي: Wali — guardian, protector, friend, and authority; here designating Ali's divinely-appointed role

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet say about Ali ibn Abi Talib as Imam and wali?
ai.summary: This hadith, narrated through Zayd ibn Arqam — a companion of the Prophet — records the Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) offering his companions guidance that would protect them from destruction and misguidance. The Prophet then declares that Ali ibn Abi Talib is their Imam and wali (guardian/leader), commanding them to consult him, follow him, and accept him as truthful. The hadith concludes with the weighty statement that the archangel Gabriel himself commanded the Prophet to convey this, establishing the divine basis for the wilayah (guardianship/authority) of Imam Ali (AS).

en.bilal-muhammad: Muhammad b. al-Hasan b. Ahmad b. al-Walid (ra) narrated to us. He said: Ahmad b. `Alawiyya narrated to us from Ibrahim b. Muhammad. He said: Al-Mas`udi narrated to us. He said: Ali b. al-Qasim al-Kindi narrated to us from Sa`d b. Talib from `Uthman b. al-Qasim al-Ansari from Zayd b. Arqam. He said:
The Messenger of Allah (s) said: Shall I not guide you to that by which, if you follow it, you will not be destroyed or misguided? They said: Of course, O Messenger of Allah.
He said: Surely, your Imam and your wali is `Ali b. Abi Talib. So, consult him, refer to him, and believe in him, for Gabriel commanded me of this.
